narrative.headline: Query first-party Haneda flight boards with precise dates, codeshares and terminal handoffs.
narrative.value_prop: Read domestic and international arrivals and departures, inspect source disruptions and published schedules, and compare your saved observations. Explicit source timestamps and unknown fields keep terminal planning grounded in what the airport actually reports.
narrative.auth_narrative: The supported source paths are anonymous. No API key, login, reservation or browser runtime is required.

quickstart.comment: Read a small current JST departure board.

quickstart.command: haneda-airport-pp-cli catalog airports --kind domestic --query 札幌 --agent
quickstart.comment: Resolve Japanese airport names and provider codes.
Resolve a flight and its terminal facilities.

troubleshoots.fix: Use today in JST for domestic boards; international boards permit yesterday through three calendar months.

troubleshoots.symptom: No gate, counter, operating carrier or actual time
troubleshoots.fix: Treat the explicit unknown field as unavailable and follow the canonical airport/airline link.
Fetch a new observation with haneda-airport-pp-cli flights search or snapshot save.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for dated Haneda public flight status, codeshare lookup, delays/cancellations, terminal planning and published schedule inspection. Use saved snapshots for explicit offline observations and change comparison.
anti_triggers: No seat or fare inventory, booking, payment or account operations.
No guaranteed connections or inferred operating-carrier/actual-time claims.

recipes.title: Small flight board
recipes.explanation: Keep useful flight facts and source time in compact agent output.

recipes.title: Domestic arrivals
recipes.command: haneda-airport-pp-cli flights search --kind domestic --direction arrival --destination CTS --limit 5 --agent
recipes.explanation: Airport and source city aliases are resolved without changing codeshare identity.

recipes.title: Disruptions
recipes.explanation: Separate airport summary counts from the returned delayed/canceled/diverted flight groups.

recipes.title: Monthly schedule
recipes.explanation: Inspect published periods and operating weekdays with explicit feed coverage.

recipes.title: Codeshare detail
recipes.command: haneda-airport-pp-cli flights detail UA8003 --kind international --direction departure --limit 5 --agent
recipes.explanation: Resolve a marketing number through the source-primary-only endpoint and bounded board fallback; retain the original listed group.

recipes.title: Padded terminal lookup
recipes.explanation: Find the same primary group with a zero-padded number and use source terminal/facility handoffs.

recipes.title: Midnight and adjacent days
recipes.explanation: Inspect explicit service and revised dates. Empty output means this observation contained no matching rollover evidence.

recipes.title: Preserve an observation
recipes.explanation: Write a complete local observation; choose a new filename if it already exists. No provider state is changed.

recipes.title: Search a saved group
recipes.explanation: After saving the preceding observation, resolve its marketing group offline with its original time and age.

recipes.title: Compare observations
recipes.explanation: First save a second board to haneda-after.json with the same date/kind/direction. No changes is a valid result; disappearance is not inferred cancellation.

recipes.title: Resolve an airline
recipes.explanation: Retain provider airline identifiers, IATA flight prefixes, Japanese names and canonical airline URLs.
